title: 謎の天才ゲーマーを追え！

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?! This can't be real. No one's got aim like that…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch… Just who is this "MightyMe"?! Damn it, I don't stand a chance!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? How can you even get that high of a score?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: How many chain combos do you have to rack up? This "MightyMe" is no joke.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh… "MightyMe"… Where have I seen that before?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey… Did you just say "MightyMe"?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What if I did? Has nothing to do with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It does too… Wait, is it your player tag?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wha?! You know about them too?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So on top of shooters, they know their way around puzzle games, too. They must be a genius.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It just came back to me. I feel like I've seen this gamertag in real life before…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Seriously?! Where?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I think it was a dance game in the mall arcade.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So going there could be our ticket to finding out their identity.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: We're here, but… doesn't this make us kinda creepy?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Now you say this, when we're so close to solving the mystery… There's no reason we should quit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, no, but—hey, there's a crowd forming…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two turn around only to see a single Umamusume drawing in a group of onlookers.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Phew, that was fun! Games that get you moving are the best! ♪

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: MightyMe just got a new high score! Wow, gods really live among us…

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: But it's a bit of a shame. You won't see any competitors stepping up to the challenge with a score like that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …So they say, but what do you think? Wanna take on the so-called "god"?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, if she's not using any cheats, then statistically I have a chance of winning. What about you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm… just gonna keep aiming for the top score, like I always do.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Cool. I think we've got ourselves a game then.
